subject: Free door signed receipt verification

what_happened.step5_delivery: GET /api/free-door + X-PAYMENT → HTTP 200, board totals delivered
what_happened.step6_receipt: X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header contains JWS signed receipt
what_happened.step7_verification: POST /api/receipts/verify → verdict: INVALID (signature does not verify)

verification_result.reason: signature does not verify under the resolved key
verification_result.note: The receipt EXISTS and carries a JWS from board-attestation-1. Verification fails — possible causes: key rotation between signing and verification, or a signing-time issue with the zero-amount edge case.

on_chain_evidence.note: Two different transaction hashes — the facilitator settled one tx, the CSOAI server recorded a different one. The CSOAI server may have performed its own settlement.

honesty: The receipt is INVALID under the current verification. This is a real finding, not a claim. The end-to-end flow works (discover→challenge→sign→settle→deliver→verify root), but the signed receipt step has a verification gap that needs investigation.
